$comment: Pins the corpus without committing it. `uv run python -m ingestion.fetch` downloads each
act to data/corpus/ (gitignored) and verifies it against sha256 here.
IMPORTANT: ISAP regenerates the 'tekst ujednolicony' PDF whenever an amendment lands, so
these bytes are a moving target by design. A checksum mismatch is NOT a corruption error --
it means the law changed. Re-pin deliberately, and treat it as a corpus change that
invalidates comparisons against metrics recorded under the previous checksum.

acts.title_pl: Ustawa z dnia 26 czerwca 1974 r. — Kodeks pracy
acts.variant_meaning: tekst ujednolicony — consolidated text with later amendments folded in
notes: The base act DU/1974/141 also serves text.html, but that is the ORIGINAL 1974 text --
Art. 1 still refers to 'socjalistycznych stosunków pracy'. Do not use it.
The official tekst jednolity was announced 2025-02-14; amendments in Dz.U. 2025 poz. 807,
2025 poz. 1423, 2026 poz. 25 and 2026 poz. 1046 postdate it. The variant U PDF is
regenerated to include them, which is why it is the chosen source.
